description: Full documentation for one utility: its parameters (kind, default, options/bounds, description), the value types it accepts/produces, tags, aliases, worked examples (input, inputEncoding, params and expected output — byte outputs there use the app's display format, while run_utility returns bytes as base64), and which runtime capabilities it needs. Call this before run_utility to learn the exact parameter names and defaults; skip it for a utility you have already described. `id` must be an exact, case-sensitive utility id: names and aliases are not resolved, so look those up with list_utilities first. An unknown id returns isError ("unknown utility: <id>"). When `unavailable` is set, run_utility and run_pipeline refuse the utility.

id.description: Utility id, as returned by list_utilities (e.g. "base64_encode").

name: describe_utility

accepts.description: Value type(s) the utility takes: string, bytes or json.

env.description: Runtime capabilities the utility needs (dom, wasm, eval, main).

examples.description: Worked examples: input, params and expected output.

params.description: Parameter name -> spec (kind, label, default, options/bounds, description…).

unavailable.description: Why this server will not run the utility, when it will not.

title: Describe utility
